mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword_id, synonym, weight, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM scenario_synonym WHERE keyword_id = #{keywordId} ORDER BY weight DESC, synonym

SELECT k.scenario_id, sy.keyword_id, sy.synonym, sy.weight FROM scenario_synonym sy JOIN scenario_keyword k ON k.id = sy.keyword_id WHERE k.scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND k.enabled = TRUE AND sy.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY k.scenario_id, sy.weight DESC, sy.synonym

SELECT k.scenario_id, sy.keyword_id, sy.synonym, sy.weight FROM scenario_synonym sy JOIN scenario_keyword k ON k.id = sy.keyword_id JOIN scenario s ON s.id = k.scenario_id JOIN scenario_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_id IS NOT NULL AND c.enabled = TRUE AND k.enabled = TRUE AND sy.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY k.scenario_id, sy.weight DESC, sy.synonym
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenario_synonym (keyword_id, synonym, weight, enabled) VALUES (#{keywordId}, #{synonym}, #{weight}, #{enabled})
